description.value: The Blue Ox Pub is a classic, cozy community pub in Lumby, BC, serving pub food and drinks seven days a week. It hosts regular events — including an annual Big Buck Contest — making it a lively local gathering spot. For touring cyclists passing through the North Okanagan on routes connecting Vernon and the Monashee corridor, it offers a full sit-down meal and bar in a relaxed atmosphere.
